summary: A late UNSUPPORTED_EDITOR_NODE_TYPE Publish response no longer points to a blocker that the user removed while the immutable Publish snapshot was in flight. Current draft edits remain dirty and can be separately saved or explicitly published. D-06, the full D point, and full Editor acceptance remain open.

behavior.race: Publish submits a cloned Page Model snapshot. If the same live Editor state is changed while the server validates that snapshot and the server returns UNSUPPORTED_EDITOR_NODE_TYPE, the error cannot be attributed to the current draft.
behavior.recovery: When the current Page Model still equals the submitted snapshot, the existing targeted unsupported-node recovery remains. When it differs, stale unsupported-node alerts are removed and a non-modal Hungarian status tells the owner that the earlier snapshot failed and the current draft must be reviewed before a separate Publish retry.
behavior.save_publish: The browser regression holds the third server rejection until after the user removes the rejected form node. It asserts the deleted node is not announced as a current blocker, no blocking dialog appears, the current draft stays separately publishable, and the existing Save/Publish route and state contracts remain covered.
behavior.reuse_and_dependencies: Used the existing Page Model, publish recovery UI, browser fixture, project scripts and Cloudflare/GitHub release pipelines. No third-party source or dependency was added.
